identity.title: [v0.91.8][provider] Route Kimi and MiniMax through adl-provider-adapter

values.task_boundary: Implement and validate the two hosted provider adapter routes and their bounded tests.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Kimi and MiniMax dispatch through adl-provider-adapter with bearer credentials.
AC-2: Requests use bounded provider-compatible model, message, and token fields.
AC-3: MiniMax billing/error envelopes and Kimi insufficient-balance responses are typed and non-retryable where appropriate.
AC-4: Focused tests prove auth, request shape, response extraction, redaction, and billing classification.
AC-5: Live probes reach both providers through the adapter and retain truthful credit-failure evidence when accounts cannot execute.
dependencies: approved Moonshot and MiniMax credential files
